response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg, t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM linked), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg, AVG(g.avg_modindex - o.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_overall FROM telescope_weather AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex GROUP BY g.weathprofile;
